review_locator: PMCID:PMC3245201, Leukocyte ligands for endothelial selectins; PMCID:PMC3680630, E-selectin ligands as mechanosensitive receptors on neutrophils
primary_title: CD44 is a major E-selectin ligand on human hematopoietic progenitor cells; Complete identification of E-selectin ligands on neutrophils reveals distinct functions of PSGL-1, ESL-1, and CD44
decision_basis: The reviews identify CD44/HCELL as an E-selectin ligand and cite primary glycoform and loss-of-function studies showing CD44-dependent E-selectin binding, rolling, and hematopoietic-cell adhesion under flow.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CD44/HCELL glycoform identity, sialylated/fucosylated N-glycans, species and cell-state differences, and E-selectin flow-adhesion context; no CD44 intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3245201, Leukocyte ligands for endothelial selectins; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
primary_title: The E-selectin-ligand ESL-1 is a variant of a receptor for fibroblast growth factor; Complete identification of E-selectin ligands on neutrophils reveals distinct functions of PSGL-1, ESL-1, and CD44
decision_basis: The reviews identify ESL-1/GLG1 as an E-selectin-selective ligand and cite primary recombinant isolation, fucosylation, antibody-blocking, and neutrophil-loss studies supporting E-selectin binding and leukocyte adhesion.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ESL-1/GLG1 fucosylated N-glycan requirement, mouse-versus-human ligand differences, and selectin flow/rolling context; no FGFR signaling or intracellular ESL-1 relay is inferred.
